name: Extended Collectibles Tracker (iotrip fix)
description:
Where the remaining stuff at?

Version 1.0.8

A fork of FranklyGD's Extended Collectibles Tracker with the freezes and stale markers fixed. It installs under its own mod id, so it sits alongside the original rather than replacing it - enable only one.

The original: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3244633122

FEATURES

- A marker on the map for every collectible your slugcat can get: data pearls, blue and gold arena tokens, red safari, green slugcat, and white broadcast tokens (Spearmaster only), each in its own colour. A marker is empty and pulsing while there is something left to do with it, and solid once there isn't: a token when you collect it, a pearl when an iterator deciphers it.
- Rooms you haven't explored get a glow instead of an exact spot, so you know something is there without being handed the location. The glow pins to the screen edge when the room is off-screen and fades with distance, which makes it a rough compass.
- On the sleep screen, one dot per pearl for each region you have visited, after the vanilla unlock row. Filled means deciphered, empty means not yet, and a dot pulsing towards white is a pearl in the shelter with you.
- On the fast travel screen, the region's token and pearl progress at a glance.
- Optional room names, labelled above each room the map is showing.
- Optional instant map, opening the moment you press the button with everything you have explored already shown, instead of a hold delay and a gradual reveal.
- Map markers, room glow, room names and instant map each have their own toggle in the Remix options.

FIXES OVER THE ORIGINAL

- The hibernation and death screens freezing, with the slugcat animation still playing and no button responding.
- Pearl and token markers going stale until the map was rebuilt on the next hibernation.
- A pearl collecting a duplicate marker a few times a second, until the pile of them froze the map and the rest of the game with it.
- Markers for pearls that have no type, pointing at pearls that aren't there.
- A carried pearl's marker sitting where the pearl was rather than where it is.

You are welcome to report bugs to me.
